messages:
violet: quick note from onboarding: brought up crescent-14b quant5 with extended-prefill (48k). reproducible checksum split vs oracle around token 24576. small log below.

omar: can you paste the run flags and minimal repro?

violet: repro cmd:
```
./onboard.sh --model crescent-14b --quant quant5 --context 49152 --prefill streaming --prefill-stride 6144 --seed 21 --kv-debug=trace
```
log snippet:
```
[2026-03-28 10:05:01] prefill.streaming len=49152 stride=6144
[2026-03-28 10:05:42] kv.checksum(oracle)=0xd4f9a3b2
[2026-03-28 10:05:42] kv.checksum(live)=0xd4f9a31e  <-- divergence @ token 24576
```

jade: 24576 = 6 * 4096; stride 6144 is an odd combination. could be a misaligned tiled write + phase interpolation rounding. did you collect ropestate and kvsync?

violet: uploaded artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/eng-ml/crest/4521 (ropestate.log, kvsync.trace, packdump.hex). ropestate shows phase_accum drift by ~2 units immediately after the tile write.

mira: try toggling ROPE_SCALE_MODE=continuous vs discrete, and set PREFILL_STRIDE=4096 and PREFILL_STRIDE=8192 to see if divergence point moves proportionally. also run an FP16 kernel fallback.

omar: also try KV_PREFILL_ATOMIC=1 to force atomic writes (might mask memcopy tail issues) and KV_PACK_TAIL=scalar to avoid vector tail path.

violet: kicking off 4 CI variants: 1) ROPE_SCALE=continuous (https://ci.redwood/eng-ml/17670), 2) STRIDE=4096 (https://ci.redwood/eng-ml/17671), 3) STRIDE=8192 (https://ci.redwood/eng-ml/17672), 4) FP16-fallback (https://ci.redwood/eng-ml/17673). infra-bot queued them.

jade: if FP16 matches oracle then quant kernel/packing is likely. if changing stride moves the split by the same delta, that points to misaligned write/windows.

mira: also add a single-shard ASYNC_KV_FLUSH=0 run to rule out cross-shard ordering. if single-shard passes, we'll diff kvsync ordering across shards.

violet: adding that now and a tiny unit test that replays first 25k tokens and asserts kv.checksum equality. posting results when CI completes (~40m). :hourglass:
